claim: Repository-resident rules (constitution/CLAUDE.md) reduce reliance on ephemeral chat memory and improve consistency.
Explicit constraints + output format instructions improve adherence; missing constraints increases drift.
Execution-based evaluation (harness/tests) is the arbiter of correctness, not narrative compliance.
Baseline systems must exclude volatile metadata (timestamps, changing receipts) to avoid nondeterministic failures.
Provenance/chain-of-custody should treat prompt + artifacts as governed entities with explicit relationships.
